weighting: One equal weight per report; distinct from the airport-equal summaries in S4.2.
configuration_coverage: 18 rows: two evaluations, each with eight complex family/block combinations and one ordinary EB reference. The compact S12 shows the ten bird-informed rows.
information_blocks: E: event; B: bird; L: landscape. E and EL are retained in national_performance.csv.
paired_contrast: Complex comparator minus ordinary EB within the same evaluation population; loss differences and limits are multiplied by 1,000. Negative values favor the complex comparator.
paired_uncertainty: 2,000 national airport resamples with fixed matched predictions. Model fitting, selection and calibration remain fixed.
rounding: Absolute scores and paired differences retain their existing independent rounding. Do not recompute paired contrasts or intervals from the displayed absolute scores.
calibration: Six parameter estimates for frozen temporal EBL predictions: calibration-in-the-large with slope fixed at one, and jointly fitted intercept/slope for each of two families. Intervals use 1,000 airport-cluster resamples; these diagnostics do not update predictions.
ranking: AUC denotes ROC AUC; AP denotes average precision. These differ from probability loss and summed O/E.
